scope: Read-only static implementation and preserved receipt audit; no reviewer probes, training, or real inference
decision: accept_for_probe source audit; no new method count or quality upgrade
input_audit: Reference purity/coverage selection, native indices, class-balanced weights, classifiers, support editing, and metric fitting use only frozen R features and the complete known MR. Q features enter only final complete-margin inference. No Q labels, host scores, external training, or additional encoder forwards are accessed.
algorithm_audit: Boosting chooses successive fixed-bank anchor stumps by reference weighted classification error and changes the complete decision; it is not multiple thresholds on one score.
Bootstrap hull vote uses16 deterministic-seed class-balanced member samples and retains each member's Frank-Wolfe gap. Members are correlated and are not independent probability evidence.
The fixed ReLU, GLVQ, and low-rank PSD routines optimize episode parameters explicitly while the DINO backbone stays frozen. They must not be described as having no parameter fitting.

Reference editing can remove rare correct support; condensed NN can retain noise and depends on fixed native order. Condensed source coverage is not a statement about query extent or equivalence to full NN.
GLVQ denominator epsilon occurs in both derivative terms. The preserved finite-difference checks support the implementation derivatives, not convergence or generalization.
The supervised metric changes a PSD distance through a rectangular matrix and uses only known-reference triplets. PSD and source role labels do not ensure that query semantic axes survive.

preserved_receipts.contract_scope: All7 preserve recorded finite full shape, query-padding background, zero-mass reference padding invariance, empty-class rules, and orthogonal-basis checks on the fixed contract inputs
preserved_receipts.scope: Unit-vector construction results, not actual DINO or a natural population benefit. Runnable distinct negative methods may be delivered with these limitations and learned failures.

nonblocking_declaration_corrections: DR09 empty-bank or uninformative-bank fallback is pure-reference nearest-neighbor in source, rather than the card's generic prototype wording. Align the card with the implementation; do not change the frozen algorithm for this wording issue.

The shared card says Q block128, while source mostly evaluates vectorized Q-by-support/anchor arrays. Declare the actual vectorized workspace and measured cost; no blocking or extra experiment is required for this harmless bounded array difference.

DR_control_average_logistic derives legal supervision from complete MR but uses weighted-quantile compression to at most64 rows per role. Do not call it an all-reference-token uncompressed logistic fit.

A Frank-Wolfe objective gap below1e-8 is a numerical tolerance statement, not literal exact maximum-margin geometry. The inherited DR08 info flag must be read with that limit; historical frozen receipts remain unchanged.
remaining_attribution_limit: DR16 initializes only the first min(8,K) anchor coordinates but its identity-metric control uses allK. Therefore any future observed learned-metric improvement needs a same-initial-matrix control to separate supervised updates from rank truncation. Current negative/no-increment reflection needs no new job or extra control to be stated honestly.
